decisions.reason: Garage door operators extend the firm's existing door and automation knowledge, so the firm can interpret early results and improve the product.
Solid wood sectional garage door lies outside the firm's metal-based manufacturing expertise, limiting its ability to learn from early results.
Garage door operator with remote control builds on the firm's operator technology and can be assimilated through its R&D.
Glazed industrial sectional door builds directly on the firm's industrial sectional door capabilities.
Glazed insulated industrial sectional door combines existing industrial door and thermal solution knowledge.
Glazed industrial sectional door is closely related to the firm's existing industrial door product line.
